Whether the FORWARD government systems pipeline holds depends on the specific program-of-record exposures scored in C2-C9 below. The segment-level concentration claim by itself passes.

summary.notes: All named DoD SATCOM PEs that VSAT's forward narrative ties to (PTS 1206761SF, PTES 1206760SF, Narrowband 1203109SF, COMSATCOM 1206445SF, WGS 1206433SF, Tactical Data Networks Enterprise 0604281F, AEHF 1206431SF, Polar 1206432SF, Evolved Strategic SATCOM 1206855SF) are FUNDED_STEADY at the 2024-09-01 cutoff. USAspending separately confirms 592 Viasat + 652 Inmarsat Government DoD awards (>$1.7B combined) with marquee program names matching the 10-K narrative (PTS field demo, MIDS-JTRS, BFT2, AMSS III, CONUS L-band, MUOS-adjacent Space Segment NA/SA). NO J-Book divergence pattern detected at this cutoff. The Signal OS J-Book primary verifier does NOT fire a negative signal on VSAT at 2024-09-01 — VSAT's forward government SATCOM pipeline is structurally supported by the Pentagon's budget direction. Any post-cutoff distress in VSAT's equity would have to come from non-J-Book causes (commercial broadband / ViaSat-3 anomaly / Inmarsat integration debt service / consumer-broadband competitive pressure) — those are out-of-scope for this cohort. C9 (SDA tactical space layer) is UNVERIFIABLE due to corpus coverage gap pre-cutoff.
